question.text: What is the correct escalation path for an investor complaint regarding mutual fund services?

answer.text: Stock Exchange → SEBI SCORES → Civil Court
Investor Service Centre / AMC senior levels → SEBI SCORES

explanation.text: The Logic: The prescribed grievance mechanism is to first approach the Investor Service Centre and then escalate within the AMC to its senior levels. If the complaint is not resolved at the AMC, the investor writes to SEBI / lodges a complaint on SCORES. AMC-level grievance redressal is to be completed within 21 calendar days. The Trap: Distributors and AMFI are not part of the formal regulatory complaint mechanism. Adding ODR to the escalation chain reads in a step that the source workbook does not list at this level. Note: Source: NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors) workbook, p.91 — ISC / AMC senior levels then SEBI / SCORES; AMC grievance redressal within 21 calendar days.
